src: tool descriptions: record_gap, validate_creative_direction, request_clarification, finalize_run
text: Record a product gap instead of hiding unsupported semantics in prompts.

src: tool descriptions: record_gap, validate_creative_direction, request_clarification, finalize_run
text: Validate this run's creative-direction.json against its delivered catalog. Checks the compact handoff and source availability, not visual quality or truth of model-authored evidence excerpts … Candidate revisions after validation need a concise revision_reason.

src: tool descriptions: record_gap, validate_creative_direction, request_clarification, finalize_run
text: Ask the user up to FOUR clarifying questions, then STOP — calling this ENDS THE TURN. Use it only as an OPENING MOVE on a genuinely under-specified brief, before any authoring … never mid-design.

src: tool descriptions: record_gap, validate_creative_direction, request_clarification, finalize_run
text: Ask ONLY for decision-critical facts you cannot derive from the prompt, conversation, document, or brand kit (asking about something derivable is a failure).

src: tool descriptions: record_gap, validate_creative_direction, request_clarification, finalize_run
text: Read the clarify-design-brief skill for the spec table and the derive-first protocol.
note: BROKEN REFERENCE: clarify-design-brief is not in the scene view (legacy tree only), so the agent cannot open it.

src: tool descriptions: record_gap, validate_creative_direction, request_clarification, finalize_run
text: Each question needs id, question, why_it_matters, optional options, a REQUIRED default ("if you don't care, I'll do X"), allow_freeform. After calling this, do NOT author, render, or finalize … Never re-ask a question a previous turn already answered.

src: tool descriptions: record_gap, validate_creative_direction, request_clarification, finalize_run
text: Finalize with this run's latest registered visual review. Missing, stale or rejected evidence still prevents acceptance. Write the current review to the active round's critique.json before accepting.
note: The follow-up routine says finalize edit_applied WITHOUT critique.json; this describes only the acceptance path.

src: tool descriptions: record_gap, validate_creative_direction, request_clarification, finalize_run
text: ops_valid_through_iteration limits draft operation replay … baseline_advisory_json records pre-existing issues; accommodation_json records accommodation moves.
